calls.title: James <> Brent EMEA catchup, 4 pm UK time (Mastiff reports)
calls.summary: The discussion centered on strategies to scale in the EMEA market by identifying high-value customer segments, with a focus on companies having at least 1 million monthly website visitors and employee sizes between 1,000 and 10,000. Engagement metrics revealed a successful breakdown of 180 opportunities that resulted in 62 wins, where the UK leads the wins tally. The software development sector emerged as the strongest performer with 16 wins, while discussions around new logo vs. expansion sales highlighted their respective win rates of 23% and 80%. Participant Brent emphasized the need for better data alignment between various sources. Innovations like transitioning to a Snowflake backend for enhanced dashboard performance were also discussed.
calls.keywords: Lead enrichment, EMEA sales performance, ICP (Ideal Customer Profile), outbound strategy, website traffic metrics, vibe code objections
